title: gbai global user config (~/.config/gbai/config.yaml)
description: Personal keys of one person for all repositories (DB_SCHEMA 3.1, D11). Project keys are accepted as a fallback the project file overrides; none is required here. Secrets never appear here, only environment variable names (R21). A null or empty optional value means unset, as the Go loader reads it.

personalKeys.description: Keys that resolve from this file only; in the project file they are ignored with a warning.

alias.description: How the assistant addresses this person (R16).

tone.description: Tone and speaking style, free text (R17).

language.description: Conversation language as a BCP 47 tag; generated artifacts stay English.
